name: Robert
title: Senior Technical Lead
about: Engineering Manager and Technical Lead with 10+ years of experience driving technical vision and architectural modernization for enterprise-scale SaaS products. I specialize in applied AI integration, distributed microservices, and high-performance mobile-to-backend systems — turning complex engineering challenges into streamlined, scalable solutions.

experience.title: Senior Technical Lead
bullets: Integrate AI pipelines across the SDLC (agents, MCP servers, workflow skills) from requirements to production.
Embed LLM capabilities into core products to transform and streamline user workflows.
Built a proprietary, multi-layered automation framework (web/mobile/offline) optimized for AI agents and non-technical QA.
Transform legacy monoliths into scalable, multi-tenant SaaS microservices to lower costs and simplify deployments.
Architect offline-first mobile-to-backend systems optimized for low-bandwidth (3G), high-latency environments.
Implement micro-frontends and Event-Driven Architectures (Azure Service Bus, Golang, Next.js) to accelerate releases.
Lead cross-functional teams across enterprise product lines (Asset, People, and Safety Management).
Revamped a legacy mobile app in 3 months, dropping a 15%+ crash rate to zero while retaining all functionality.

experience.title: Technical Lead
bullets: Integrating AI into products to bring impact and change day in life of users.
Implementing multi-tenant architecture for SaaS services, reducing costs and enabling seamless new tenant deployment.
Implementing micro-frontend architecture to help products go live easier.
Introducing new technologies to team: Golang and Next.js.
Developing libraries (C# and TypeScript) for logging, background services, and more — helping developers move faster.
Leading multiple teams on Asset Management and Safety Management products targeting Coal Mining tenants.

experience.title: Technical Lead
bullets: Work as Tech Lead, maintaining and improving the way team works on the codebase.
Defining standards and structures used across all codebases.
Developing apps using Next.js (React), Node.js, Golang (Fiber), and Django Rest Framework.
Led migration of all legacy React projects to Next.js and Django projects to Golang, improving developer experience and performance.
Worked in a Scrum team of 12 with 3-week sprints.

totalExperienceNote: 10+ years of professional experience (2016 – present), including Senior Full-Stack, Technical Lead, and Engineering Manager roles across fintech, energy, and enterprise SaaS.
